title: 90s Photo Filter for iPhone: Point-and-Shoot Film Look
description: Make iPhone photos look like a 90s point-and-shoot: 35mm film color, flash, grain and the orange date stamp. Which looks to use and how to apply them.
h1: 90s photo filter: the point-and-shoot film look on iPhone
card_summary: 35mm compact cameras, on-camera flash and the orange date, on any photo.
quick_answer: A 90s photo was usually shot on a 35mm compact or a disposable: crisp but slightly soft color, visible grain, a direct flash indoors and an orange date in the corner. In Halatto, choose Titan 38 (premium 90s compact), Mju 35 (pocket point-and-shoot in black and white) or Snap 400 (disposable), add the Retro flash for indoor shots and the date stamp, then save.
intro: The 90s look is film, not digital: no sensor noise, no crunchy JPEG, but grain, warm skin and a flash that makes everyone glow.
Here is how to pick the right camera for the photo and finish it the way a lab print looked.

sections.heading: Which 90s camera for which photo
list: Titan 38: city trips, portraits, golden hour. Crisp, cool shadows, warm highlights.
Mju 35: black and white street and friends. Hard contrast, big grain.
Snap 400 and Snap Gold: parties, holidays, the camera that went around the table.

steps.heading: Step by step: 90s look in Halatto

items.name: Open the photo
items.text: Pick a photo in Halatto or share it from Photos.

items.name: Choose a 90s camera
items.text: Tap Titan 38, Mju 35 or Snap 400 in the Looks strip.

items.name: Stamp the date
items.text: Open Date stamp and choose the bottom right corner.

items.name: Save or develop the roll
items.text: Save it, or save a recipe and use Develop the Roll for the whole album.

tips.heading: Tips
items: Crop to 3:2, the shape of a 35mm frame.
A slight Aging fade makes it look like a print from an album, not a fresh scan.
Use one camera for the whole set; 90s albums were one or two rolls.

faq.question: What app gives the 90s filter on TikTok and Instagram?
faq.answer: Many apps do. Halatto gives the 90s point-and-shoot and disposable looks on photos you already took, with flash and the orange date.

faq.question: Can I make a 90s look in black and white?
faq.answer: Yes. Mju 35 is a black and white pocket point-and-shoot with hard contrast and big grain.

faq.question: Is the 90s look the same as Y2K?
faq.answer: No. 90s is film; Y2K usually means early digital cameras. See the digicam filter guide for that look.
